### α_D² scaling audit (auto-generated from JSON, r34 Sci-2 fix)

For each Γ/ρ, the ratio σ(α_next)/σ(α_prev) / (α_next/α_prev)² is computed from adjacent α_D pairs. **Summary stats below use 15-decimal precision.** The previous 6-decimal display was misleading — it rounded machine-epsilon deviations (~4×10⁻¹⁶) to 1.000000. The actual ratios are 1.0 to ±4.4×10⁻¹⁶, which is the noise floor for `scipy.integrate.quad` with `limit=100`.
